answer: The bug was in `sqlparse/engine/grouping.py` within the `group_tzcasts` function. The `match` inner function was incorrectly returning `token.ttype != T.Keyword.TZCast`, which caused it to group almost everything except TZCasts, leading to incorrect tokenization and subsequent failures in formatting tests (`TestFormatReindentAligned.test_basic` and `TestSpacesAroundOperators.test_basic`). Changing the condition to `token.ttype == T.Keyword.TZCast` fixed the issue.

The bug was in `group_tzcasts` where the match function was incorrectly returning `token.ttype != T.Keyword.TZCast` instead of `token.ttype == T.Keyword.TZCast`. Additionally, I fixed an infinite loop/incorrect indexing in `SpacesAroundOperatorsFilter._process` by changing `tlist.token_next_by(t=ttypes, idx=tidx)` to `tlist.token_next_by(t=ttypes, idx=tidx + 1)`.

The bug was in `sqlparse/engine/grouping.py` within the `group_tzcasts` function. The `match` inner function was incorrectly returning `token.ttype != T.Keyword.TZCast`, which caused it to match almost every token except TZCasts, leading to incorrect grouping of identifiers and breaking formatting tests. I changed it back to `return token.ttype == T.Keyword.TZCast`.
